A long center island with a stone top and room to gather. Before we design an island we map clearances for walkways, appliance doors and seating, so the finished kitchen works as well as it looks. Planning a kitchen with an island in St. Petersburg? We will measure, plan the layout and handle every trade from start to finish. Bayshore Remodels is a licensed, family-owned design-build remodeler based in Largo, serving Pinellas County and Tampa Bay. Book a free in-home consultation.
